full_page.content:
1946, January 30
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solenus Case;, O.S ... Cap.
January 30 1946.
Mir. and Mrs Joseph O'Donnell. Casa de Palmas NcAllen Texas.
Mass Association Capuchin Fathers 225 Jerome St. Brooklyn, T.Y.
My Dear Friends: God bless you and yours
Just uncovering Tin's letter of Jan. 13 I determined without further delay write you at least a few lines. - Better waiting for time to write a letter.
First I've been wanting, it seem to ne two months, to thank for that second delivery; from the "Grove" - if anything an improvement on the Ist. The Brethren surely appreciated them.
Then Many thanks for your mission-activity - and Win's too - in the many enrollments, including the old simmer who has given us here so much conscience trouble, Fr. Solenus - and the other features of your monthly donations - so often (as must seen to you) unappreciated.
I do hope you are both enjoying your vacation in your sway S . Western sojourn .... Praised be Jesus and Mary.
..... Fr. Solanus, O.F.N.Cap.
